label: late copy phase, dominated by the final output of length-3 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>), and only on repeated inputs (in_first=0), mostly within the last 2 outputs (to_go<=1 holds about 88% of mass). The strongest and cleanest part is the last step of L=3 sequences (t=5, outputting orig(2)): it fires on about 92% of those steps and they hold about 44% of the activation mass, including all of the top activations (e.g. q o e <DEL> q [o]). In longer sequences firing is sparse and depends on the token: inputs m, h, o, i, n are enriched 3-6x. Precision outside the L=3 core is low (most late copy steps with those inputs do not fire), and some activations fall at to_go 2-5 with other inputs. Never fires at recall_idx 0 or 1 or at to_go >= 6.
